content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: clicking Save on the purchase order:new screen shows a full-screen overlay right away and keeps it for about 15 s with no visible error or progress indicator in the windows, so the user has no feedback while the save runs and then clicks Save again.", "fix": "Fix: on the purchase order:new screen, change the Save button's click handler so it disables the button and shows an inline spinner on the Save button instead of the blocking full-screen overlay, and log the save request's duration to find out why it takes about 15 s.", "cited_event_ids": ["418", "420:w448", "423", "424:x459"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The windows contain no network or server events, so the cause of the 15 s delay (request latency, server processing, or client work) cannot be confirmed.", "The overlay's element identity and whether it blocks input by design are not in the events.", "The second Save click is recorded at coordinates (0,0), so it may be a keyboard or programmatic activation and its meaning is uncertain.", "Whether the save ultimately succeeded is not shown in the windows."]}
